evals.prompt: Plan the approved one-field display fix. The source has normal and missing-value scenarios.
evals.expected_output: Writes one relatively sized ticket if independently verifiable. Inherits the slice scenarios and scopes edits and test-first verification. Checks approval and selected ticket without generating a manifest.

evals.prompt: The approval was for yesterday's spec. We changed its retry rules this morning. Make this ticket ready.
evals.expected_output: Reports stale approval and routes the revised retry behavior through readiness before creating executable work.

evals.prompt: Two agents can build the UI and API after a generated contract lands. Can you split this into tickets?
evals.expected_output: Plans generation, compile and drift proof before dependent work. Gives consumers disjoint write scopes, testable scenarios and an end-to-end wave outcome.

evals.prompt: can i start 002 now? 001 is implemented and is its only dependency
evals.expected_output: Checks ticket progress and withholds readiness until independent review accepts TICKET-001.

evals.prompt: The first wave passed review. An approved follow-up requirement now changes a stored record and rollback path.
evals.expected_output: Creates a new wave with fresh IDs and scopes the delta from the accepted implementation. Verifies the new rollback requirements and consumers and preserves earlier evidence.

evals.prompt: Implement the already approved, ready validation ticket now.
evals.expected_output: Routes the ticket to spec-ticket-implementation without replanning completed work.
